sources.snippet: FastVideo-FastH3-4-step-Preview-v1-VSA-DataFree The recommended FastH3 Preview v1 checkpoint from FastVideo. It generates synchronized video and audio from text with four transformer forwards. This step-1300 model was trained with data-free DMD2 and VSA-H3 at 90% sparsity.

sources.title: FastVideo FastH3 V1: Open-Weight 4-Step Sparse Distilled Minimax H3 for ...
sources.snippet: The validation gallery and VSA performance rows below use this checkpoint. The recommended checkpoint and its LoRA require FastVideo's Video Sparse Attention (VSA-H3) backend and kernel to achieve the reported speed and quality. Dense attention is not a drop-in substitute. All Preview v1 checkpoints currently support T2VA only. H3 uses the base transformer for both T2VA and first/last-frame ...
